text:
arjun: Heads-up — I pushed quartz14b weights to S3 and noticed the tokenizer.json on HF doesn't match. s3 path: s3://models-prod/quartz14b/v1/, hf origin: hf://bigmodels/quartz14b/v1. Can someone check checksum + tokenizer compatibility before we flip the registry pointer?

arjun: Quick sanity: weights sha256 on S3 is `3a7f9d2b...c1e9` (partial shown). Manifest at s3://models-prod/quartz14b/v1/manifest.json.

maria: Got it. I'll diff the tokenizer files. Do you have the HF tokenizer sha?

arjun: HF tokenizer sha listed in their repo tag: `tokenizer@f2b1c4`. Main diff is pad/unk ordering and an extra `|` special token. Example snippet:
```diff
- "pad": 0
- "unk": 1
+ "pad": 1
+ "unk": 0
+ "special_tokens": ["|", "<extra>"]
```

maria: That ordering will break our loader if we assume pad=0. Two quick options: 1) normalize tokenizer during ingest (shim), or 2) keep HF tokenizer canonical and remap weights/tokenizer on our mirror. Which do we prefer?

tess: For rollout speed I'd vote shim in ingest path, add a compatibility test in `ci/tokenizer_compat_test.py` and a small transform step. We can revert later if upstream changes.

arjun: shim sounds fine. Just want to ensure we record transform and checksum. Also presign TTL: Ops asked for 1h but our CI presign step sometimes fails if under 30m. Recommend presign 2h for this ingest.

sam: Re: ACLs — when you uploaded did you set bucket owner control? If not, mirror job may fail with `AccessDenied` on `PutObjectAcl`. Use `--acl bucket-owner-full-control` or set object ownership on upload.

arjun: I uploaded via internal script that should set it, but I'll double-check.

leo: I'll run a checksum verify and kick the mirror after tokenizer shim PR is ready. Running: `aws s3 cp s3://models-prod/quartz14b/v1/weights.tar.gz - | sha256sum`.

leo: Verify complete: `3a7f9d2b1a4f...c1e9` matches manifest. no corruption.

artifact-sync-bot: mirror job queued -> registry://redwood/models/quartz14b:v1. Estimated completion 12m.

maria: I'll open the shim PR now (PR #568) with the transform and a small test set. cc @eng-ml.

tess: Thanks — once PR lands can someone run the internal `scripts/validate_artifact.sh` (it checks tokenizer order, manifest checksum, and presign flow). Command:
```bash
./scripts/validate_artifact.sh --s3 s3://models-prod/quartz14b/v1 --hf hf://bigmodels/quartz14b/v1 --presign-ttl 7200
```

arjun: I'll run that after PR merge. If mirror finishes and tests pass, we can flip the pointer and add a note to the model catalog about the tokenizer shim. :white_check_mark:

maria: PR opened -> https://git.internal/redwood/eng-ml/pulls/568. Short description + test vectors.

leo: Mirror finished successfully and registry now has `quartz14b:v1` (checked registry digest). Rolling to canary on dedicated pool.

arjun: Awesome. Please leave comments on the PR about long-term plan (either upstream patch or permanent shim).

tess: I'll add a follow-up task to triage upstream alignment.

sam: Noted re: ACLs — confirmed object owner is bucket owner. No action required.

maria: LGTM — closing the loop. Thanks everyone. :tada:
